Priya (People Ops): Quick check — day-of ops for the candidate on 2026-03-20. Need mic check and virtual lobby link. Can someone confirm panelists + whether we need live captions? :wave:
Jordan (Eng): I'm on the panel. Can you drop the candidate Slack/link?
Elena (Hiring): Panel confirmed: Jordan, Samir, Aisha. Zoom link is `https://zoom.us/j/123456789` (meeting locked 5m after start). Virtual lobby will be #candidate-2026-03-20 — I'll post the join link there.
Samir (ML): I can do the mic/test audio at 10:20 (10m before). Quick rubric Q — do we still use 60/40 design vs implementation, or adjust?
Priya (People Ops): Good Q. Org rubric default is 60/40 but hiring team can override. For this role let's set 55/45 (design/implementation). I'll annotate the invite.
Jordan (Eng): Works for me. Where do we capture scores — Google form or Notion?
Elena (Hiring): Use the "Interview Scores" Notion template (we standardized this month). Link: https://redwood-inference.notion.site/interview-scores — I'll attach to the invite.
Priya (People Ops): I'll paste the Notion template into the calendar invite and enable the score reminder. Also accessibility ask: candidate requested captioning and slide alt text — can someone confirm slides have alt text?
Samir (ML): I'll run through the slides and add alt text + speaker notes by EOD today.
PeopleOps-Bot: Reminder scheduled: 15 minutes before interview. :bell:
Jordan (Eng): If the candidate is 5–10 minutes late, do we proceed or reschedule?
Elena (Hiring): Proceed if <=10m and shorten intro if needed; if >10m, offer reschedule and capture reason in the debrief.
Priya (People Ops): OK — handoff plan: I'll post the quiet-room keycode, the virtual lobby join link, and the Notion score template 30m before. Please react with :thumbsup: once you see the calendar update so I can close this thread.
Jordan (Eng): :thumbsup:
Samir (ML): :thumbsup:
Elena (Hiring): :thumbsup:
Priya (People Ops): Done — calendar updated, Notion attached, mic check scheduled. I'll also pin the candidate chat in #candidate-2026-03-20 30m prior. Closing this thread.
